Signal a koine contract-violation error

Source: R/conditions.R
koine_abort.Rd

Raises a classed condition of subclass koine_error_<code> (and the parent classes koine_error and error). The code must be one of the closed error taxonomy in Stage-0 SS12; an unknown code is itself an error, because a silent, untyped failure would violate charter hard-rule 2.

Usage

koine_abort(code, message, ...)

Arguments

code

Single string; one of .koine_error_codes.

message

Human-readable message.

...

Extra named fields attached to the condition for inspection.

Value

Never returns; always stops.
